timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Ever heard of cosmic lighthouses that emit beams of radiation?
Welcome to the world of pulsars.
Pulsars are rapidly spinning neutron stars that emit beams of radiation.
They're like cosmic lighthouses, sending out pulses of light.
Why do some pulsars spin incredibly fast, while others don't?
The reasons behind their varying spin rates remain one of astronomy's and solved puzzles.
Can you fathom the forces that play in these cosmic wonders?
Share your thoughts below and don't forget to like and follow for more space adventures.
